label: 5. Don't you think it's been a bit chilly

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Don't you think it's been a bit chilly

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: in the Fitness Club lately?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I was sweating bullets today.
You're always perspiring.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Talk about hitting someone when they're down...

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Uh-oh... starting to sweat again...

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Coach is right.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: You're not exactly an ideal sample size.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I ended up cutting my session short because it was such a freezer in there.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: That's because you're gliding around on a skateboard.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: If you were trudging along on foot, you'd break a sweat too.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I did get off the board and walk, and I was freezing cold then too.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: How about you, Coach?

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Aren't you cold?
Hard to say.
Actually, I thought it was a bit hot as well.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: That at least means you weren't overly cold, right?

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Hey, don't coerce him.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: You too?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: See? I'm not the only one!
Maybe it's different for me since I'm not a Nikke?

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Hmm, good point.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: How about this, Epinel.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I could give you a nice, big hug.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: That might warm you up a bit and get a good sweat going.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: No thanks.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Yikes, talk about the cold shoulder.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I'm hurt, but it's also refreshing in a way since you're so frigid.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I want to hear other Nikkes' opinions.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I don't feel that it's overly cold either.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If anything, I think it's a tad on the warm side.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Finally, someone who gets me!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: It's been a long, lonely road up until this point.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Am I the only one that feels cold?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If you're really that cold,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: then I can show you some exercises that'll get you working up a sweat in no time.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Thanks, but no thanks.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I'm just going to train somewhere outside the gym.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Somewhere a bit warmer.
I think that's a good idea.
